title: Dimglass Coast - Buoy-Light Drift
_note: Sparser explore-light ambient. gbc 4-voice, no chords. 104 BPM, 4/4, G major, Light-leaning. Lead = thin pulse25 stating ONLY the Vesper lift fragment (D4->G4->A4), widely spaced, answered by bell sparkle. Harmony = bright ascending bell figures (Light signature) over slow Tide chimes. Bass = slow sustained drifting roots. Percussion = a single soft foam-wash brush per bar. 16-bar loop. The route's hook reduced to a glint so it never fatigues.
